items.summary: Recommendation: retain only the six reversible task-routing repairs and preserve the financial admission gate. For the 30-day Amazon window pulled 2026-10-02, reported activity was $5.20 commission, 5,992 clicks, 31 ordered items, and 7 shipped items; the commission is aggregate and unattributed, so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, causal lift, and forecasts are unsupported. AI usage for 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02 was $54.5828597 across 359 calls with 22 errors, but only 28 of 40 expected sites are instrumented. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because period-aligned attributable outcomes and labor rates are absent. Budget exposure is not calculable because monthly limits, infrastructure/domain costs, and labor costs are blank. Minimum measurement: period-aligned site/content ledger linking registered affiliate IDs, attributable commission, AI and infrastructure cost, labor effort/rates, and outcome deltas. No money movement, billing changes, banking access, contracts, or financial claims are authorized.
